scripts.text: You're carrying too many items. Please make some room in your bag first.
scripts.translation: 你携带的物品太多了。请先腾出一些背包空间。

scripts.text: You're overweight with items. Please lose some item weight first.
scripts.translation: 你的物品负重超限了。请先丢弃一些物品。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
What are you, a baby?
I'm not here to babysit. Get lost!
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
你是小孩子吗？
我可没空照看你。滚开！

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
Ha ha, are you also seeking new knowledge?
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
哈哈，你也是来寻求新知识的吗？

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
I'm sorry, but my knowledge doesn't concern you.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
抱歉，我的知识与你无关。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
Well, you've met all the qualifications except one: you need the Release spell.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
嗯，你只差一个条件就都符合了：得先学会“释放”技能。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
Learn the spell first. I've got so many things to tell you.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
先学会那个技能吧。我还有很多事情要告诉你。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
Welcome, my friend.
Congratulations on entering a brand new world of magic.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
欢迎，我的朋友。
恭喜你踏入全新的魔法世界。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
We magic practitioners are always thirsty for new knowledge and power.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
我们这些魔法师总是渴求新的知识与力量。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
We endure great hardship and pain to achieve what we want. When we finally do, the sense of accomplishment defies description. That's why both you and I have chosen the way of magic.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
为了达成目标，我们会忍受巨大的艰辛与痛苦。终于成功时，那份成就感难以言喻。这就是你我选择魔法之路的原因。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
By the way, what brings you to me today?
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
对了，你今天来找我有什么事？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text: Do you know the Reading Spell Book?
scripts.translation: 你知道“阅读魔法书”吗？

scripts.text: What's the Freezing Spell?
scripts.translation: 什么是“魔法保存”？

scripts.text: Can I have a Magic Book?
scripts.translation: 能给我一本魔法书吗？

scripts.text: Can I use the Reading Spell Book without the Freezing Spell?
scripts.translation: 没有“魔法保存”也能使用“阅读魔法书”吗？

scripts.text: About the Ultimate Magic Book
scripts.translation: 关于终极魔法书

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
Hah! You're silly.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
哈！你真傻。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
Reading Spell Book literally means 'read a spell book.' Do you know how to use Magic Books?
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
“阅读魔法书”顾名思义就是阅读魔法书。你知道怎么使用魔法书吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 知道

scripts.text: No, I don't.
scripts.translation: 不知道

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
Well then, you don't need an additional lecture.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
既然如此，就不用我额外讲解了。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
Magic Books are an advanced type of magic scroll. While spells on scrolls disappear after one use, the ones in Magic Books can be cast multiple times.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
魔法书是更高级的魔法卷轴。卷轴上的咒语使用一次就会消失，魔法书中的咒语则可以反复施放。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
Let's compare a spell on a scroll to a wire. When the wire is used to open a door or do something else, it's bent and crushed, losing its original shape. A spell from a Magic Book is more like a shape memory alloy.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
可以把卷轴上的咒语比作铁丝。铁丝用来开门或做其他事情后，就会弯折变形，失去原来的形状。魔法书中的咒语则更像形状记忆合金。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
Huh, don't you now what shape memory alloy is? Eh, just remember this: a wire made from shape memory alloy restores its shape over time.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
咦，你不知道什么是形状记忆合金？呃，只要记住：这种合金制成的铁丝会随时间恢复原状。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
Like the alloy, a spell on a Magic Book remains after a use, although reusing the spell has a downtime for its restoration.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
同样，魔法书里的咒语使用后不会消失，只是需要经过一段时间才能再次施放。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
...Oh, I didn't mean to talk for too long. Anyways, you can use Magic Books to cast spells that you've learned. Its concept is different from normal spells.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
......啊，我说得太多了。总之，魔法书能让你施放已经学会的咒语，其原理和普通施法不同。

scripts.text: What's the difference?
scripts.translation: 有什么不同？

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
Why do you have to write your existing spells in Magic Books, you asked?
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
你是问，为什么要把已经学会的咒语写进魔法书？

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
That's a good question. It's related to Magic Binding.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
问得好，这和魔法束缚有关。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
You already learned Release, which allows you to hold the energy of the four different elements before the actual casting. Magic Binding is similar to Release.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
你已经学会“释放”了吧？它能让你在正式施法前，先 保持四种元素的能量。魔法束缚也和它类似。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
Since you've learned Release, you're capable of using Magic Binding as well. Well, let's talk about that later.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
既然你学会了“释放”，也就能使用魔法束缚。这个之后再说。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
You know how to hold an existing spell, and then cast it at a desired timing via Release.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
你知道怎么通过“释放” 保持已有的咒语，再在合适的时机施放。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
Carrying the globes of the four elements is also related to Magic Binding.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
携带四种元素之球也和魔法束缚有关。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
As you know, the four elements are Fire, Water, Wind, and Earth. Being able to employ them freely is the essential principle of magic.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
如你所知，四大元素是火、水、风、地。能自由运用它们，才是魔法的基本原理。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
We Humans use torches to keep fire, fans to blow wind, and bowls to hold water. We also use clay to make earthenware.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
人类会用火把保存火种，用扇子生风、用碗盛水，也会用黏土制作陶器。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
Those activities may differ from magic, but both are the same in the sense of employing the four elements.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
这些做法虽和魔法不同，但本质上都是在运用四大元素。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
When you use complex magic spells to summon a storm, drop lightning, or burn an area, that consumes a lot of your energy, both physically and mentally.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
施展复杂的魔法来召唤风暴、降下闪电或焚烧一片区域，会大量消耗体力和精神力。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
When you fail to bind such powerful magic spells or fail to control them, you can receive irreparable damage to your mind and body.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
若无法束缚或控制如此强大的魔法，身心都可能受到无法挽回的伤害。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
That's why we use Magic Books to reduce that burden. It helps summon pre-cast spells while you're focusing on binding their magic power.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
所以我们才用魔法书减轻负担。当你专心束缚魔力时，魔法书能帮你召唤预先准备好的咒语。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
There's one downside though: Magic Books cannot be used for spells that you haven't learned.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
不过魔法书也有个缺点：你没学会的咒语无法用它施放。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
As I said earlier, spells in Magic Books tend to go back to what they are.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
就像我刚才说的，魔法书里的咒语总会恢复原状。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
That said, as a Circler, you cannot change or create spells in Magic Books.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
不过，身为环术士，你无法修改或创造魔法书里的咒语。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
Even if you create one, its power will be beyond your capacity.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
即使创造出新咒语，其威力也会超出你的控制能力。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
In order to use the Reading Spell Book, you must learn the Freezing Spell to bind magic.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
想使用<阅读魔法书>，必须先学会<魔法保存>来束缚魔力。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
The Freezing Spell is used for Magic Binding. It helps you to insert a magic spell to a circle.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
<魔法保存>是用于魔法束缚的技能，可以把咒语封入法阵。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
Circles of magic work organically with each other. When you use the Freezing Spell to bind a spell, the spell won't activate until you cast the release spell.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
各个魔法法阵会彼此协调运作。用<魔法保存>束缚咒语后，必须再施放<释放>才能发动。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
Of course, binding a spell continuously consumes your mana, but it consumes less mana than conventional magic spells.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
持续束缚咒语当然会消耗魔力，不过比直接施放普通魔法消耗得少。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
Magic Binding becomes more difficult when you use more powerful magic spells.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
魔法越强大，束缚起来就越困难。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
For weak spells, you can bind two to three of them with your circle. For more powerful spells, maybe one or two is possible.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
较弱的咒语可以用法阵束缚两三个，威力更强的咒语大概只能束缚一两个。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
That all depends on your ability to control your spells. You'll have to try and experience Magic Binding after you first learn it to really understand.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
这完全取决于你控制咒语的能力。学会之后亲自尝试、体验魔法束缚，才能真正理解。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
I'm sorry, but I only have Magic Books for beginners, but they're obviously not suitable for you. Do you still want one?
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
抱歉，我这里只有初学者用的魔法书，显然不适合你。你还想要吗？

scripts.text: Sure thing.
scripts.translation: 当然要

scripts.text: Where can I find advanced books?
scripts.translation: 高级魔法书要去哪里找？

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
Please go talk to [Lea] in the Archive. Tell her that you need one of the Magic Books that I've stored in there.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
去档案馆找莉亚，告诉她你想要一本我存放在那里的魔法书。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
For your information, she won't give it to you without anything in return. Expect her to ask you for something!
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
先提醒你，她不会白白给你，肯定会向你索要东西！

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
I'm sorry, but our management has recently decided to limit the availability of Magic Books for Multi Circlers. It's because their numbers are increasing more quickly than we expected.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
很抱歉，管理层最近决定限制多环术士使用的魔法书数量，因为这类术士的数量增长得比预期快。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
You could find one if you try hard, but I don't have any with me.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
努力找找也许能找到一本，不过我手上没有。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
If our management releases the restriction, you'll be the first one to know. Don't worry.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
如果管理层解除限制，我会第一个告诉你。别担心。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
Nothing will happen when you try to bind magic without using Magic Binding because you have nothing to hold magic.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
不使用魔法束缚就想束缚魔法，什么也不会发生，因为你没有容纳魔力的媒介。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
It's like water that needs a bowl to stay in place.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
就像水需要用碗来盛一样。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
The problem is when you try to forcefully cast a spell that you haven't learned. It'll definitely backfire on you.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
真正的问题是，若强行施放自己没学过的咒语，一定会遭到反噬。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
Of course, the damage won't be severe: you'll fall asleep or be thrown into confusion. This is all because there's a conflict between your Magic Book and the force of Magic Binding when you're trying to summon and hold a unlearned spell.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
当然，伤害不会很严重：你可能会睡着或陷入混乱。这是因为你试图召唤并束缚尚未学会的咒语时，魔法书与魔法束缚之力发生了冲突。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
Don't try it out just to see what happens for yourself! Falling asleep while casting a spell? There's nothing more humiliating than that to magic practitioners like us.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
别为了好奇而亲自尝试！施法时睡着？对我们这些魔法师来说，再没有比这更丢脸的事了。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
I'm sorry, but could you ask someone else? I'm kind of busy right now.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
抱歉，能去问问别人吗？我现在有点忙。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
Huh, are you looking for the Ultimate Magic Book? Who sent you?
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
嗯？你在找终极魔法书吗？是谁告诉你的？

scripts.text: Ms. Lea.
scripts.translation: 莉亚小姐

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
I'm sorry, but there's not much information left about the Ultimate Magic Book.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
抱歉，关于终极魔法书，能留下来的资料已经不多了。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
A few scholars in the Midgard Continent once tried to collect ancient Magic Books and reproduce that book, but...
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
曾有几位米德加尔特大陆的学者试图收集远古魔法书，仿制出那本书，可是......

scripts.text: But what?
scripts.translation: 然后呢？

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
Oh yes, perhaps he might know something.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
对了，也许他知道些什么。

scripts.text: Yes, I knew this was coming!
scripts.translation: 好啊，我就知道你会这么说！

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
My brother is just like you. He's very interested in recreating the Ultimate Magic Book.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
我弟弟和你一样，对重现终极魔法书很感兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
His name is Galfos.
He's been taking a great interest in the ancient Magic Books.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
他叫加尔佛斯，一直对远古魔法书很着迷。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
I didn't support him or give him any advice for his research since I thought he'd give on it pretty quickly, but...
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
我原本不支持他，也没给他的研究任何建议，以为他很快就会放弃......可是......

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
If he's discovered anything useful, maybe it can helpful to you.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
如果他发现了什么有用的东西，或许能帮到你。

scripts.text: Where's Galfos now?
scripts.translation: 加尔佛斯现在在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
I've heard that he's near the Expedition Camp beyond the Dimensional Rift to seek information about the ancient Magic Books.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
听说他在次元裂缝另一端的远征营地附近，调查远古魔法书的资料。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
If you want to see him, you should prepare for a long journey.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
想见他的话，得做好长途跋涉的准备。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
Galfos is near the Expedition Camp beyond the Dimensional Rift.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
加尔佛斯就在次元裂缝另一端的远征营地附近。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
If you want to see him, you should prepare for a long journey.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
想见他的话，得做好长途跋涉的准备。

scripts.text:
[Master Velofos]
Ha ha, I'm sorry, but you should focus on strengthening your body rather than creating Magic Books.
scripts.translation:
[维洛佛斯大师]
哈哈，抱歉，不过你还是先锻炼身体吧，暂时别想着制作魔法书。

scripts.text: You're carrying too many items. Please make some room in your bag first.
scripts.translation: 你携带的物品太多了。请先腾出一些背包空间。

scripts.text: You're overweight with items. Please lose some item weight first.
scripts.translation: 你的物品负重超限了。请先丢弃一些物品。

scripts.text:
[Lea]
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[莉亚]
有什么可以帮您？

scripts.text: Master Velofos asked me to bring his Magic Book.
scripts.translation: 维洛佛斯大师让我来拿他的魔法书。

scripts.text:
[Lea]
Are you borrowing a book?
scripts.translation:
[莉亚]
你是来借书的吗？

scripts.text: Let me think.
scripts.translation: 我再想想

scripts.text: I want the Intermediate Magic Books.
scripts.translation: 我想借中级魔法书

scripts.text: I want the Superior Magic Books.
scripts.translation: 我想借高级魔法书

scripts.text: I want the Ultimate Magic Books.
scripts.translation: 我想借终极魔法书

scripts.text:
[Lea]
No problem.
scripts.translation:
[莉亚]
没问题。

scripts.text:
[Lea]
Ah, so you want the Intermediate Magic Books. If you pay a ^4d4dffloan deposit of 100,000z^000000, we will lend you an Intermediate Magic Books.
scripts.translation:
[莉亚]
哦，你想借中级魔法书。缴纳^4d4dff100,000z押金^000000后，就可以借阅一本。

scripts.text:
[Lea]
What kind of Magic Book do you want?
scripts.translation:
[莉亚]
你想借哪种魔法书？

scripts.text: Let me think.
scripts.translation: 我再想想

scripts.text: Magic Book (Storm Gust)
scripts.translation: 魔法书（暴风雪）

scripts.text: Magic Book (Lord of Vermillion)
scripts.translation: 魔法书（怒雷强击）

scripts.text: Magic Book (Meteor Storm)
scripts.translation: 魔法书（陨石术）

scripts.text:
[Lea]
No problem.
scripts.translation:
[莉亚]
没问题。

scripts.text:
[Lea]
You already have that Magic Book. You can't borrow a new book until you return the current one.
scripts.translation:
[莉亚]
你已经借了这本魔法书。归还之前，不能再借新的。

scripts.text:
[Lea]
Thank you for your deposit. The book's return date is written on the lending card on the back cover of the book. Please try not to lose or damage the book and avoid paying compensation.
scripts.translation:
[莉亚]
押金已收到。归还日期写在书封底的借阅卡上。请妥善保管，别弄丢或损坏，否则要赔偿。

scripts.text:
[Lea]
The ^4d4dffloan deposit is 100,000z^000000. The deposit has adjusted as the Magic Book has changed.
scripts.translation:
[莉亚]
^4d4dff押金为100,000z^000000。魔法书变更后，押金也作了相应调整。

scripts.text:
[Lea]
Don't you know how many others would want the book you already have? It's a bit selfish to want more than one, you know.
scripts.translation:
[莉亚]
你知道还有多少人想借你手里的那本书吗？一本都不够，还想再借一本，未免太自私了。

scripts.text:
[Lea]
The Intermediate and Superior Magic Books must be returned upon borrowing the Ultimate Magic Book. Remember that you're just borrowing them, so make sure you take good care of those books.
scripts.translation:
[莉亚]
借终极魔法书时，必须归还中级和高级魔法书。别忘了书只是借给你的，一定要好好保管。

scripts.text:
[Lea]
Oh, do you want the Superior Magic Books? The policy has been changed to accept loan deposits unconditionally, instead of the existing demanding loan conditions.
The Superior Magic Book ^4d4dffloan deposit is 500,000z^000000.
scripts.translation:
[莉亚]
哦，你想借高级魔法书？现在只要缴纳押金就能借，不再需要满足以前那些苛刻条件。
高级魔法书的^4d4dff押金为500,000z^000000。

scripts.text:
[Lea]
What kind of Magic Book do you want?
scripts.translation:
[莉亚]
你想借哪种魔法书？

scripts.text: Let me think.
scripts.translation: 我再想想

scripts.text: Magic Book (Drain Life)
scripts.translation: 魔法书（吸星大法）

scripts.text: Magic Book (Jack Frost)
scripts.translation: 魔法书（冰冻穿孔）

scripts.text: Magic Book (Earth Strain)
scripts.translation: 魔法书（地牛翻身）

scripts.text: Magic Book (Crimson Rock)
scripts.translation: 魔法书（碧血陨石）

scripts.text: Magic Book (Chain Lightning)
scripts.translation: 魔法书（连锁电击）

scripts.text:
[Lea]
No problem.
scripts.translation:
[莉亚]
没问题。

scripts.text:
[Lea]
You already have that Magic Book. You can't borrow a new book until you return the current one.
scripts.translation:
[莉亚]
你已经借了这本魔法书。归还之前，不能再借新的。

scripts.text:
[Lea]
Thank you for your deposit. The book's return date is written on the lending card on the back cover of the book. Please try not to lose or damage the book and avoid paying compensation.
scripts.translation:
[莉亚]
押金已收到。归还日期写在书封底的借阅卡上。请妥善保管，别弄丢或损坏，否则要赔偿。

scripts.text:
[Lea]
The ^4d4dffloan deposit is 500,000z^000000. The deposit has adjusted as the Magic Book has changed.
scripts.translation:
[莉亚]
^4d4dff押金为500,000z^000000。魔法书变更后，押金也作了相应调整。

scripts.text:
[Lea]
Don't you know how many others would want the book you already have? It's a bit selfish to want more than one, you know.
scripts.translation:
[莉亚]
你知道还有多少人想借你手里的那本书吗？一本都不够，还想再借一本，未免太自私了。

scripts.text:
[Lea]
The Intermediate and Superior Magic Books must be returned upon borrowing the Ultimate Magic Book. Remember that you're just borrowing them, so make sure you take good care of those books.
scripts.translation:
[莉亚]
借终极魔法书时，必须归还中级和高级魔法书。别忘了书只是借给你的，一定要好好保管。

scripts.text:
[Lea]
Did... Did you just say the Ultimate Magic Book?
scripts.translation:
[莉亚]
你......你刚才说终极魔法书？

scripts.text:
[Lea]
Oh, my....
I can't believe someone actually wants that book.
scripts.translation:
[莉亚]
天哪......
真不敢相信，居然真的有人想借那本书。

scripts.text: Please don't say that you don't have it.
scripts.translation: 拜托，别告诉我你没有。

scripts.text:
[Lea]
Frankly, I've never even seen the Ultimate Magic Book.
scripts.translation:
[莉亚]
老实说，我连终极魔法书都没见过。

scripts.text:
[Lea]
You should ask Master Velofos if you want to know more about that book.
scripts.translation:
[莉亚]
想了解那本书的话，去问维洛佛斯大师吧。

scripts.text:
[Lea]
I'm sorry that I can't help you more than that.
scripts.translation:
[莉亚]
抱歉，我帮不了你更多。

scripts.text:
[Lea]
You should ask Master Velofos for some information about that book.
scripts.translation:
[莉亚]
那本书的事，你应该去问维洛佛斯大师。

scripts.text:
[Lea]
Well... why don't you practice a little longer before that?
scripts.translation:
[莉亚]
嗯......在那之前，你不妨再多练习一阵子。

scripts.text:
[Lea]
In order to obtain the Ultimate Magic Book, you must reach Level 140 and learn Tetera Bolt and Comet.
scripts.translation:
[莉亚]
想获得终极魔法书，必须达到140级，并学会泰特拉之箭和毁灭彗星。

scripts.text:
[Lea]
That book can't be used by just anyone, you know?
scripts.translation:
[莉亚]
那本书可不是谁都能使用的，知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Lea]
Welcome to the Magic Archive. You can read and borrow books from here under certain conditions.
scripts.translation:
[莉亚]
欢迎来到魔法档案馆。满足一定条件后，就可以在这里阅读和借阅书籍。

scripts.text: You're carrying too many items. Please make some room in your bag first.
scripts.translation: 你携带的物品太多了。请先腾出一些背包空间。

scripts.text: You're overweight with items. Please lose some item weight first.
scripts.translation: 你的物品负重超限了。请先丢弃一些物品。

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
What are you, a baby?
I'm not here to babysit. Get lost!
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
你是小孩子吗？
我可没空照看你。滚开！

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
My right arm feels hot while my left arm feels cold. I can never get used to this weird weather!
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
我的右臂发热，左臂却发冷。我怎么也适应不了这古怪的天气！

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
Ah, I'll get myself in trouble if I stay here any longer. Maybe I'm already in...
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
啊，我要是继续待在这里，肯定会惹上麻烦。说不定已经惹上了......

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
I'm sorry, but I don't talk to people that aren't even ready for this.
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
抱歉，我不和还没准备好的人说话。

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
You look strong, but you don't seem to have any business with me.
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
你看起来挺强，不过似乎没什么事要找我。

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
What brings you to me?
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
找我有什么事？

scripts.text: I heard that you've studied the Ultimate Magic Book.
scripts.translation: 我听说你研究过终极魔法书。

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
Why, are you interested too?
I didn't know someone would actually take an interest in that book. Yes, I'm studying that magic book. How did you find that out?
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
怎么，你也感兴趣？
我没想到真有人会对那本书感兴趣。没错，我正在研究。你是怎么知道的？

scripts.text: You're Velof's brother, right?
scripts.translation: 你是维洛佛斯的弟弟，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
Yes, I'm Galfos, and Velofos is my brother.
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
没错，我是加尔佛斯，维洛佛斯是我哥哥。

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
Wait a minute,
did the old man recommend me to you?
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
等一下，
是那个老家伙推荐你来的？

scripts.text: That's right.
scripts.translation: 没错。

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
Wow!
This is surprising. He never took my research very seriously. I'm glad that he finally changed his mind.
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
哇！
真没想到。他从来没把我的研究当回事。很高兴他终于改变主意了。

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
Heh! Your timing couldn't be better: I was looking for a test object.
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
你来得正好，我正缺个测试对象。

scripts.text: A test object?
scripts.translation: 测试对象？

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
Frankly, I'm only interested in creating the Ultimate Magic Book.
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
说实话，我只想制作终极魔法书。

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
I'm not good at using magic, not to mention that I prefer fists in fighting. Nevertheless, I find Magic Books to be incredibly intriguing.
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
我不擅长使用魔法，更喜欢用拳头解决问题。不过，我觉得魔法书实在太有意思了。

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
The problem is that I can't use the Ultimate Magic Book, even if I made one. That's why I can't really test it on my own.
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
问题是，即使我做出了终极魔法书，也没法自己使用，所以不能亲自测试。

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
That's why I've been waiting for a true magic practitioner like you that can help me test my Ultimate Magic Book.
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
所以我一直在等一位像你这样的魔法师，帮我测试终极魔法书。

scripts.text: (What is he talking about?)
scripts.translation: （他在说什么？）

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
My research is almost done,
and I need to solve one last problem to create the Magic Book.
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
我的研究已经接近完成，只差解决最后一个问题，就能制作出魔法书。

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
To make the ancient Ultimate Magic Book, I need an artifact and some spells to fuse into it.
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
要制作远古终极魔法书，我需要一件神器，并将一些咒语融合进去。

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
I've perfectly restored the spells based on the ancient documents, but I still have no information about the necessary artifact.
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
我已经根据古代文献完美复原了咒语，但还没找到有关那件神器的资料。

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
Ah, but there's a silver lining!
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
不过，好消息是......

scripts.text: (Now we're getting somewhere!)
scripts.translation: （终于有进展了！）

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
Ha ha...
There's a great archive in El Dicastes, the Capital City of the Evil Giants, where all knowledge in this world is stored.
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
哈哈......在邪恶巨人的首都埃尔迪卡特斯，有一座大型档案馆，收藏着世间所有知识。

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
Maybe that's the place to find some information about the artifact for this Ultimate Magic Book.
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
或许能在那里找到制作终极魔法书所需神器的资料。

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
You know what to do, don't you? Find information about the artifact in the El Dicastes archive, using everything in your power.
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
知道该怎么做了吧？尽你所能，去埃尔迪卡特斯档案馆寻找神器的资料。

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
Afterwards, create and bring me the artifact. We'll talk about creating the Magic Book afterwards.
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
找到资料后，制作出神器带给我。之后再谈制作魔法书的事。

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
You know what to do, don't you? Find information about the artifact in the El Dicastes archive, using everything in your power.
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
知道该怎么做了吧？尽你所能，去埃尔迪卡特斯档案馆寻找神器的资料。

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
Afterwards, create and bring me the artifact. We'll talk about creating the Magic Book afterwards.
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
找到资料后，制作出神器带给我。之后再谈制作魔法书的事。

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
Oh, did you find
anything useful?
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
哦，有找到什么有用的资料吗？

scripts.text: I've discovered everything about Comet.
scripts.translation: 我已经掌握了“毁灭彗星”

scripts.text: I've mastered the zenith of Tetra Vortex.
scripts.translation: 我已经掌握了“属性漩涡”

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
Are you kidding me? You already have the book!
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
你在开玩笑吗？你已经有那本书了！

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
Oh my, I sense incredible energy coming from you. This is great! Now we're ready to make the Ultimate Magic Book.
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
天哪，我感受到你身上涌出惊人的能量。太好了！现在可以制作终极魔法书了。

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
Are you sure that you've found something? It doesn't seem like you've learned what we need...
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
你确定找到资料了吗？看起来你还没学会我们需要的东西......

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
There's one problem, though: I'm so broke that I don't even have enough money to buy the tools to make the book.
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
不过还有个问题：我穷得连买制书工具的钱都没有。

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
I need at least ^0000aa500,000 zeny^000000 to buy all the necessary tools. Do you have the money?
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
我至少需要^0000aa500,000 Zeny^000000购买所有必要的工具。你带够钱了吗？

scripts.text: Wh-what? No!
scripts.translation: 什、什么？没有！

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 有，当然。

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
Aw, you don't? It's disappointing, but there's nothing I can do. Come back when you have enough money, okay?
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
啊，没有吗？真可惜，不过我也没办法。攒够钱再来吧，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
Alright then, let's get started!
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
好，那就开始吧！

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
Hey, what did I tell you? I can't buy the tools to make the book without money!
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
喂，我说什么来着？没钱就买不到制作魔法书的工具！

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
Man, I almost lost my control to the incredible magic energy! Here's your Magic Book.
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
天哪，我差点被那股惊人的魔法能量控制住！这是你的魔法书。

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
Thank you for making my dream come true. Feel free to come back if you need another one of these books.
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
谢谢你帮我实现梦想。还想要这种魔法书的话，随时可以再来。

scripts.text:
[Galfos]
Is there anything else you need?
scripts.translation:
[加尔佛斯]
还需要别的东西吗？

scripts.text: I better not forget to equip my ring.
scripts.translation: 我可得记得装备戒指。

scripts.text: When you approach the documents, an Evil Giant that looks like the archive manager tries to call Guard Galton. You should get out of here quickly.
scripts.translation: 你靠近文件时，一个伪装成档案馆管理员的邪恶巨人似乎正要呼叫加尔顿卫兵。赶快离开这里。

scripts.text: The documents are making you feel nauseous. You should come back later after your stomach settles.
scripts.translation: 这些文件让你感到恶心。等胃舒服些再回来吧。

scripts.text: You don't feel as nauseous anymore. It should be safe to proceed now.
scripts.translation: 恶心感已经消退，现在应该可以继续了。

scripts.text: The documents in this container aren't legible. It's no use trying to read them.
scripts.translation: 容器里的文件无法辨认，读了也没用。

scripts.text: You have discovered records about magic, acceleration, and particle waves.
scripts.translation: 你发现了有关魔法、加速和粒子波的记录。

scripts.text: You have discovered records about magic, acceleration, and particle waves. These documents must be the ones that Galfos is looking for.
scripts.translation: 你发现了有关魔法、加速和粒子波的记录。这些一定就是加尔佛斯想找的文件。

scripts.text: You already own this document.
scripts.translation: 你已经有这份文件了。

scripts.text:
^660066In order to create the essence of lava, you must refine 40 Burning Hearts at the hottest place on the 2nd floor of the Thor's Volcano Dungeon.^000000
^660066You must do this by using the greatest power in that place. The Humans have used this method to study the acceleration of magic particles since ancient times.^000000
scripts.translation:
^660066要制作熔岩精华，必须在托尔火山洞窟二楼最炽热的地方精炼40颗燃烧的心脏。^000000
^660066必须借助那里的强大力量才能完成。自古以来，人类就用这种方法研究魔法粒子的加速。^000000

scripts.text: You have discovered the ^990099Lava Essence Creation Method^000000. Please check your Quest window for more details.
scripts.translation: 你发现了^990099熔岩精华制作方法^000000。详情请查看任务窗口。

scripts.text: Nothing in this document looks useful.
scripts.translation: 这份文件看起来没有什么有用的信息。

scripts.text: You already own this document.
scripts.translation: 你已经有这份文件了。

scripts.text:
^660066The essence of flame can be refined on stable ground on the 1st floor of the Thor's Volcano Dungeon. 10 Love Coals are necessary to refine the essence.^000000
^660066According to Humans' information, this essence constitutes one of the four natural elements.^000000
scripts.translation:
^660066火焰精华可以在托尔火山洞窟一楼地势稳定的地方精炼。精炼需要10块爱的煤炭。^000000
^660066根据人类的资料，这种精华是四大自然元素之一。^000000

scripts.text: You have discovered the ^990099Flame Essence Creation Method^000000. Please check your Quest window for more details.
scripts.translation: 你发现了^990099火焰精华制作方法^000000。详情请查看任务窗口。

scripts.text: Nothing in this document looks useful.
scripts.translation: 这份文件看起来没有什么有用的信息。

scripts.text: You already own this document.
scripts.translation: 你已经有这份文件了。

scripts.text: ^660066I succeeded in refining the essence of glacier deep inside the 3rd floor of the Ice Cave. If you'd like to try, prepare 10 Ice Hearts and go to the following location.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660066我成功在冰洞三楼深处精炼出了冰川精华。想试试的话，准备10颗冰之心，前往下方地点。^000000

scripts.text: You have discovered the ^990099Glacier Essence Creation Method^000000. Please check your Quest window for more details.
scripts.translation: 你发现了^990099冰川精华制作方法^000000。详情请查看任务窗口。

scripts.text: Nothing in this document looks useful.
scripts.translation: 这份文件看起来没有什么有用的信息。

scripts.text: You already own this document.
scripts.translation: 你已经有这份文件了。

scripts.text:
^660066I was able to refine the essence of fossil from old rocks on the 2nd floor of the Mine Dungeon. So far, that place is the most stable among all the testing grounds.
If you'd like to try, prepare 10 Jubilees and go to the dungeon. Good luck.^000000
scripts.translation:
^660066我在矿山洞窟二楼用古老岩石精炼出了化石精华。到目前为止，那里是所有试炼地点中最稳定的。
想试试的话，准备10个朱比利再前往洞窟。祝你好运。^000000

scripts.text: You have discovered the ^990099Fossil Essence Creation Method^000000. Please check your Quest window for more details.
scripts.translation: 你发现了^990099化石精华制作方法^000000。详情请查看任务窗口。

scripts.text: Nothing in this document looks useful.
scripts.translation: 这份文件看起来没有什么有用的信息。

scripts.text: You already own this document.
scripts.translation: 你已经有这份文件了。

scripts.text:
^660066In order to refine the essence of storm, I visited the Hermit's Checkerboard in Kunlun where the spirit of the wind resides.
The refining process was easy, but I had a hard time finding the catalyst, Dragon Teeth.^000000
scripts.translation:
^660066为了精炼风暴精华，我去了昆仑的隐士棋盘，那里栖息着风之精灵。
精炼过程很简单，不过寻找催化剂龙牙可费了我不少功夫。^000000

scripts.text: You have discovered the ^990099Storm Essence Creation Method^000000. Please check your Quest window for more details.
scripts.translation: 你发现了^990099风暴精华制作方法^000000。详情请查看任务窗口。

scripts.text: Nothing in this document looks useful.
scripts.translation: 这份文件看起来没有什么有用的信息。

scripts.text: You suddenly feel sick, and this nausea won't go away easily. You should try finding the documents you need later.
scripts.translation: 你突然感到一阵恶心，而且久久无法缓解。稍后再来寻找需要的文件吧。

scripts.text: Nothing here looks special.
scripts.translation: 这里看起来没什么特别的。

scripts.text: You no longer need to search this place.
scripts.translation: 你不必再搜索这里了。

scripts.text: Please lighten your bag.
scripts.translation: 请先减轻负重。

scripts.text: You have used {0} to create ^999900{1} Essence^000000.
^008800The {0} Essence will last permanently, unless there's a problem.^000000
scripts.translation: ^008800{0}精华将永久保存，除非出了什么问题。^000000

scripts.text: ^008888You have failed to refine the essence using {0}.^000000
You've already created {0} Essence in this area.
scripts.translation: 你已经在该区域制作过{0}精华。

scripts.text: Someone already used this area.
scripts.translation: 该区域已经有人使用过了。
